rationale: The agent executed order-changing writes (modify_pending_order_address and modify_pending_order_items) without first confirming with the user, violating the confirm-before-write requirement. Authentication was insufficient (only a name+ZIP lookup and direct use of the provided user_id), and there’s no clear verification the referenced orders belong to the user. The user also asked to correct all order addresses and the user profile address; the agent only modified one order’s address and did not update the user’s saved address or clarify limitations/hand off. It’s unclear if the jigsaw order had shipped, yet the agent proceeded to modify items without stating status or asking for confirmation. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
